news.title: Muslim World League Condemns Terrorist Houthi Militia Attack on Jazan Oil Refinery
news.og_title: Muslim World League Condemns Terrorist Houthi Militia Attack on Jazan Oil Refinery
news.og_desc:
Makkah, November 27, 2026, SPA -- The Muslim World League (MWL) has strongly condemned the continued illicit aggression by the terrorist Houthi militia against Saudi Arabia, recently targeting an oil refinery in Jazan Region, which resulted in the death of one worker and injuries to others of various nationalities.
    In a statement, MWL Secretary-General Sheikh Dr. Mohammed Al-Issa denounced the treacherous terrorist assault, affirming that such acts violate all religious values as well as international and humanitarian laws and norms, and demonstrate the militia's criminal nature and deliberate targeting of civilians and civilian infrastructure.
    Speaking on behalf of the league's academies, bodies, and global councils, as well as the Muslim peoples represented under its umbrella, Sheikh Al-Issa reaffirmed full solidarity with Saudi Arabia in all measures taken to deter aggressors and safeguard national security and the safety of citizens and residents, praying to Almighty Allah to protect the Kingdom, its leadership, and its people from all harm.
    -- SPA
10:34 Local Time 07:34 GMT
